column1: # fonts components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
# Ids are family names (each font's first); the preview draws a sample in the family's regular style.
mode    families    -       font families by name                          default
toggle  mono        alt-m   monospace families only                        -
action  copy        ctrl-y  copy the family names                          silent,builtin
action  copy-files  alt-y   copy the families' font files                  notify
action  folder      alt-O   open the folder of each family's regular font  silent
